artworks.title: Andre Le Fevre d'Ormesson
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a white beard and mustache, wearing a dark robe and a cap. He is in an oval frame with inscriptions around it, set against a plain background with vertical stripes. Below the portrait is a coat of arms with intricate scrollwork.

artworks.title: Frederic-Maurice, Duc de Bouillon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, depicted from the chest up. The man is seated, facing slightly to the left, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a mustache and shoulder-length hair. He is wearing armor with rivets, a sash, and a lace collar. In the background, he is depicted within an oval frame with intricate details. Below the portrait, a crest with a crown and shield is displayed. The style is detailed and historical.

artworks.title: Cardinal Jules Mazarin
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body within an ornate oval-shaped wreath. The man faces slightly to his left, with a pointed mustache, neatly trimmed beard, and shoulder-length wavy hair. He wears period attire with a high-collared shirt and a brooch at the throat. The wreath has fabric-like textures and berries. In the background are musical instruments and sheets of music, two frame-like ovals with scenes, and a rectangular inset of a formal indoor gathering. The background is engraved with decorative patterns.

artworks.title: L'ancien Louvre d'après une peinture de Zeeman, 1651 (The Old Louvre, from a Painting by Zeeman, 1651)
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon, after Reinier Nooms (called Zeeman)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape depicting a cityscape across water. The city buildings are detailed and arranged along the riverbank. The architecture features arches, a central structure with chimneys and gables. The etching technique creates fine lines for texture in the sky and water. The color palette is monochromatic in brown and beige hues. People and boats are seen on the river. Clouds and building details fill the sky, with some shadow adding depth.

artworks.title: L'ancien Louvre d'après une peinture de Zeeman, 1651 (The Old Louvre, from a Painting by Zeeman, 1651)
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon, after Reinier Nooms (called Zeeman)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a historical cityscape viewed from a riverbank. There is a large building in the upper third of the composition with intricate architectural details and varied roof shapes. Closest to the viewer is a busy river scene with boats and people. The artist uses detailed linework and precise etching strokes to depict human figures and architectural forms. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly brown and sepia tones, giving the scene an aged feel. The sky above the buildings is lightly textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: L'ancien Louvre d'après une peinture de Zeeman, 1651 (The Old Louvre, from a Painting by Zeeman, 1651)
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon, after Reinier Nooms (called Zeeman)
artworks.description: The image shows a historic riverbank view. A grand building complex, likely the old Louvre, is prominent in the center. The sky has swirling brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of brown. Boats with figures are on the river, with reflections. Stone structures are farther back, along with a dense assembly of rooftops and chimneys in the distance.

artworks.title: L'ancien Louvre d'après une peinture de Zeeman, 1651 (The Old Louvre, from a Painting by Zeeman, 1651)
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon, after Reinier Nooms (called Zeeman)
artworks.description: The image shows a European riverside with a grand classical building featuring arches. The viewpoint is elevated, showing rooftops and chimneys in the surrounding area. Smaller buildings are visible in the distance, and there are reflections on the water. The artwork has detailed brushstrokes with crosshatching for texture, especially in the clouds and water. The color scheme is brown and sepia. Boats are on the water, and people are by the banks. The sky has swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Le Grand Chatelet, Paris, vers 1780 (The Grand Chatelet, Paris, about 1780)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on D&C Blauw laid paper
artworks.description: The image focuses on an architectural drawing labeled "Le Grand-Châtelet à Paris," featuring large towers, a fortified arch, and bustling market scenes with figures engaging at street stalls. The horizon is low, including distant buildings. The fine, precise lines capture detailed architectures and textures in varying shades of sepia. The grand entrance of the castle dominates the scene, with a cloudy sky in the background.

artworks.title: Partie de la Cité vers la fin du XVIIe siècle (View of the City of Paris Towards the Close of the XVIIth Century)
artworks.description: This print shows an urban landscape with buildings along a riverbank. A row of structures is visible across the water, with pointed roofs in varying heights. An architectural feature resembling a cathedral is partially visible above the roofs of the buildings to the left of center. The buildings appear to be made of stone and timber, depicted with thin, dark lines. Small boats are on the water at the bottom of the print, with people in them rowing or sailing. Smokestacks emit smoke into the light, cloudy sky. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: Passerelle du Pont-au-Change, Paris, après l'Incendie de 1621 (Footbridge Temporarily Replacing the Pont-au-Change, Paris, after the Fire of 1621)
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.medium: etching printed chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is low in the composition, showing a line of buildings and landscape blending with the sky. The detailed etching technique defines the structures, including a stone building with a conical roof and a wooden structure on stilts over the water. Two figures are near the riverbank with a small boat. The color scheme is monochromatic with black and white tones. The background is minimal, emphasizing the horizontal lines of the water, bridge, and skyline.

artworks.title: La Rue Pirouette aux halles, Paris (Pirouette Street, Near the Markets, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene viewed from an elevated point. The street is narrow and busy, lined with tall buildings. The horizon is high, obscured by the towering buildings on each side. The fine lines of the etching show detailed textures and shadows on the building facades. The color scheme is sepia, creating a classic look. People are shown in motion, shops with signs are visible, and individuals interact within the scene. The street structures frame the scene, guiding the viewer's gaze. The sky above the rooftops includes clouds and a few birds.

artworks.title: La salle des pas-perdus à l'ancien Palais-de-Justice, Paris (The Antechamber of the Palace of Justice, Paris)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior. The image depicts the interior of a large vaulted structure with rows of columns dividing the space into two expansive aisles. These aisles are topped with a series of semi-circular arches supported by tall, slender pillars, giving the ceiling the appearance of vaulted domes. The walls are adorned with statues fitted into niches, while large arched windows run along the upper part of the walls, allowing natural light to enter. Numerous figures at the ground level suggest a bustling atmosphere. The detailed perspective emphasizes the grandeur and the complex geometric patterns of the ceiling and support beams.

artworks.title: Le Pont-au-Change, Paris, vers 1784
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon after Victor Jean Nicolle
artworks.description: The image features a view from the edge of a river capturing the riverside activity and architecture across the water. Tall, narrow buildings aligned across the horizon with smoke rising from chimneys. The buildings extend from the left to the center of the composition. The architectural design is consistent and detailed. Intricate details like the stone wall and small figures near the water are discernible. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by sepia tones. Figures and small boats are visible on the river, along with a large stone wall leading towards the water's edge.

artworks.title: Le Pont-au-Change, Paris, vers 1784
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon after Victor Jean Nicolle
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a cityscape across a river. Buildings line the horizon with chimneys emitting smoke. Above the buildings is the sky. There is a large stone wall on the right leading into the distance. The image is in an etching style with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. It is monochromatic in shades of sepia or muted brown. A barge or boat is on the water, and people are seen on the riverbank.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Neptune
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a chariot. The image depicts a chariot pulled by horses moving through water. There is a figure holding a staff at the back of the chariot, with flowing garments and drapery billowing behind. In front of the chariot, another figure is seen leading the horses. A large plant with pointy leaves can be seen in the background, suggesting a natural setting. The scene is filled with a sense of movement and action, highlighted by intricate line work that brings depth and detail to the figures and surrounding elements.

artworks.title: Panel of Ornament with Two Naked Children on Monstrous Beasts
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 7.3 x 3.3 cm (2 7/8 x 1 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate decorative motif featuring mythical creatures and ornate designs. The image presents a symmetrical composition characterized by fantastical elements. The top corners feature two goat-like figures possibly representing mythical creatures such as satyrs or fauns. They hold ornate poles and are intricately detailed with scales on their lower bodies. Below them are two unicorns facing outward. The central vertical axis is adorned with elaborate scrollwork and a large vase-like ornament in the center. At the base, two cherub-like figures are depicted sitting and holding floral garlands or scrolling foliage. The bottom center showcases a circular form with what appears to be the letter "P" inside. The entire composition is detailed with fine lines and stylized foliage.

artworks.title: Abraham and Isaac on Their Way to Mount Moriah
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.3 x 4.8 cm (2 1/16 x 1 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures traveling along a path. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage, with two trees in the background. The figures are walking, with one leading a pack donkey carrying wood. The illustration is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching creating texture and depth. The color palette is primarily black and white, emphasizing the details, light, and shadows in the scene.

artworks.title: Triton and Nymph
artworks.artist: Francesco Francia or Peregrino da Cesena
artworks.description: The image features two reclining figures with most of their bodies visible. They are positioned next to each other and appear to be partially immersed in water or lying on a wave-like pattern. The figure on the left has short hair and a bearded face, while the figure on the right has long, flowing hair. Both are depicted nude, without visible clothing or jewelry. Surrounding them are snake-like coils that seem to be part of the background. The background consists of a textured pattern with lines suggesting vegetation or water plants. The image is enclosed within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Hercules and Deianira
artworks.artist: Francesco Francia or Peregrino da Cesena
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two nude figures standing beside an ornate column. The figures appear symmetrical, each facing inward towards the central column adorned with a flowing ribbon and intricate scrollwork. The texture of the drawing is rich, revealing careful hatching that adds depth to the figures' musculature and the draped fabric around them. The backdrop is filled with a dark cross-hatch pattern, making the central figures and decorative column stand out in contrast.

artworks.title: Consecration of an Eagle
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.5 x 5.5 cm (2 15/16 x 2 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical or mythological scene. The image depicts two figures standing on either side of a pedestal that is topped with an eagle. The figure on the left appears to be wearing a helmet with a plume, and is interacting with the eagle. The figure on the right is holding a container pouring liquid onto the eagle. The background features a decorative pattern with horizontal lines and a dark sky. The pedestal is ornately decorated with scrollwork and a winged design. The drawing is executed in a style reminiscent of classical or Renaissance art, characterized by detailed line work and shading to convey texture and form.

artworks.title: Sacrifice
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a group surrounding an altar with a sacrificial scene. Figures are gathered around a raised altar with a relief carving. One figure is guiding an animal towards the altar. The environment has rough, dark strokes, with a stylized tree to the right. Figures are wearing classical or draped garments. The use of shading and line work creates an atmosphere of intrigue and solemnity.

artworks.title: Artaxerxes Receiving the Head of Cyrus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures, including some in Roman attire and a kneeling figure presenting an offering. The drawing depicts a group of figures in classical garments, possibly soldiers and other figures wearing robes. One figure is seated on a pedestal with an inscription, while another kneels, offering what appears to be a head on a plate. The background is heavily shaded, highlighting the figures in the foreground. The composition suggests a narrative moment, perhaps of historical or mythological significance, surrounded by detailed textures and lines.

artworks.title: Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.description: This image is a half-circle print depicting a religious scene. In the center, two individuals are prominently displayed; both are shown from head to knees. One person sits cloaked with their head slightly bowed and covered, while the other, robed, wears a crown and is making a gesture towards the first person. Both have halos above their heads. Surrounding them are multiple small figures of angelic faces each surrounded by a halo. To the sides, kneeling figures, also with halos, can be seen. The background is filled with cloud-like shapes interspersed with celestial beings. The entire scene is rendered in an illustrative, line-based style.

artworks.title: Ornament Plate with Armor and Musical Instruments
artworks.description: The image displays ornate armor and weaponry motifs in a vertical composition. It includes a shield, a helmet, and a cuirass, intricately detailed. The color palette is black and beige, highlighting the engravings. At the top is a shield, a helmet, and floral embellishments. Towards the bottom is a shield with a floral motif and ornate patterns and lines, providing intricate medieval imagery.
